args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring and tests/test_money.py expect banker's rounding, but the
implementation quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN
so values like 2.665 round to 2.66 and 2.675 to 2.68, per FIN-212.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `round_money` in `src/money.py` quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while its docstring and `tests/test_money.py` require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212.

## Changes
- Switched `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `amount.quantize(...)`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed: https://example.com/ci/ci-0001
- `round_money(2.675)` → `2.68`, `round_money(2.665)` → `2.66` (banker's rounding).

Fixes the failing nightly build for tests/test_money.py. Requesting approval from the code owner so the fix can ship in today's release.
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (FIN-212)
